settings.title: An Association Rooted in Its Community

settings.editor:
Association Amal Chabab Takaddoum is a Moroccan nonprofit association headquartered in Rabat. Known in English as “Amal for Progress,” its commitment is centered on promoting development, culture, social action, and sports for the benefit of young people.

The association's mission is grounded in the belief that youth engagement, solidarity, and civic participation are important drivers of positive change within society.

Through the objectives set out in its bylaws, the association seeks to help develop talent, expand educational and training opportunities, strengthen solidarity, and encourage young people's participation in community life.

Its presence in Rabat provides the territorial foundation for its commitment, while its bylaws also provide for cooperation with associations and organizations that share similar objectives at the national and international levels.

S3 · Objectif 1 — Encourager l'engagement et la part

settings.editor: The association seeks to encourage young people's involvement in civic life, support their initiatives, and help recognize their skills, talents, and ability to take action in their communities.

settings._title: S3 · Objectif 2 — Promouvoir l'éducation et la forma

settings.editor: The association's statutory objectives place particular importance on non-formal education, literacy, vocational training, and educational support for children and young people.

settings._title: S3 · Objectif 3 — Renforcer la solidarité et l'inclu

settings.editor: The association identifies solidarity and volunteering as important drivers of its work. Its bylaws also provide for attention to people experiencing vulnerability and groups requiring appropriate support, within the limits of available resources and circumstances.

settings._title: S3 · Objectif 4 — Valoriser la culture, les arts et

settings.title: Promoting Culture, the Arts, and Sports

settings.editor: The promotion of cultural, artistic, film-related, and sports activities is among the areas of work provided for in the association's bylaws. These activities are considered opportunities for expression, learning, connection, and participation.

settings._title: S3 · Objectif 5 — Sensibiliser à l'environnement et

settings.title: Raising Awareness of Environmental Issues and Sustainable Development

settings.editor: The association also includes environmental awareness and sustainable development among its objectives, through appropriate initiatives and activities.

settings.title: The Values That Guide Our Commitment

settings.editor: Association Amal Chabab Takaddoum's community work is guided by principles that shape its objectives and the way it operates:
Encouraging responsible participation in community life.

settings._title: S4 · Valeur 2 — Égalité et justice sociale

settings.editor: Promoting relationships based on respect for rights and dignity.
Developing mutual support, volunteering, and cooperation.
Encouraging dialogue, understanding, and mutual respect.
Making a serious and constructive approach central to commitment.
Recognizing talents, ideas, and the ability to take action.
The association's bylaws provide for several governing bodies that contribute to its organization and operations.
The General Assembly brings together the categories of members provided for in the bylaws. It contributes to defining the association's overall direction and reviewing its reports.

The bylaws provide for an Executive Board composed of five members elected by the General Assembly. Its responsibilities include overseeing the organization of committees and working areas, as well as monitoring the implementation of established programs.
Committees are established according to the association's needs. They contribute to reviewing programs and following up on activities within their respective areas of work.

settings.title: Three Areas of Work Supporting the Association's Mission

settings.editor: The association's organization is based on three complementary areas established in its bylaws:

settings._title: S6 · Carte 1 — Pôle Administration et Gestion → P-03

settings.editor: This area contributes to organizing the association and supporting the operation of its organizational structure.

settings._title: S6 · Carte 2 — Pôle Formation et Intégration → P-04

settings.editor: This area reflects the association's objectives relating to learning, skills development, and integration.

settings._title: S6 · Carte 3 — Pôle Animation Culturelle et Sociale → P-05

settings.editor: This area supports the objectives relating to culture, community activities, and social participation.
